_comment: Golden request/response/document shapes for POST /api/admin/vendors/applications/invite (mission vendor-invite, M1/F1). Timestamps are shown as ISO strings for readability; the real documents store Firestore Timestamp instances, converted to Date by lib/firestore-serialization.ts on read.

fieldErrors: contactEmail is required and must be a non-empty string

inviteResponse_409_pendingConflict.error: An application from this email is already pending review (id: xyz789). Approve or decline it instead of creating a duplicate invite.

inviteResponse_409_approvedConflict.error: An approved application from this email already exists (id: xyz789) with a live registration code. Use Reissue code to resend it instead of creating a duplicate invite.

inviteResponse_503_secretUnset.error: Cannot invite: VENDOR_REGISTRATION_TOKEN_SECRET is not configured, so the registration code could never be redeemed. No invite was created.

invitedDocument_afterCreate._note: tradingName, vendorCategory, indicativeBoothCount are ENTIRELY ABSENT keys on this document -- not present with value undefined/null/[] -- see goldens/README.md 'Why vendorCategory and indicativeBoothCount become optional'.

publiclyAppliedDocument_forComparison._note: Shown only to contrast with invitedDocument_afterCreate above -- a pre-mission, publicly-submitted, still-pending document. Has no origin key at all (origin absent means 'public' by convention) and DOES carry vendorCategory/indicativeBoothCount because the public apply form always collects them.
